This file contains integration notes for the word frequency CLI tool implementation.

## Implementation Details

The implementation follows the specification in `spec.md`:
- Input validation checks for exactly two arguments (input and output paths)
- Input file existence and readability are validated
- Input must be valid JSON array of strings
- Output is sorted by original string order (not frequency)
- Case-sensitive counting of words

- Empty input array
- Single word input
- Multiple words with duplicates
- Error cases (missing input, invalid JSON, etc.)
